metadata.usage_note: Reviewed precedent only. Guide, do not blindly copy. Convert DataType-like targets to actual resource-level paths and remap non-allowed domains. When precedent conflicts with the BA principles below, the principles win.

ba_principles: FHIR for social welfare: choose the structurally/semantically closest resource; NEVER reject a candidate resource for being clinical / healthcare / claim / medical oriented. Every candidate rejection reason must be structural or semantic.
Domain drives FHIR category; Outcome Plan comes from the Care Provision category (CarePlan, CareTeam, Goal, ServiceRequest, RiskAssessment, RequestGroup).

Provenance, AuditEvent, and Consent ONLY for tables whose core purpose is security, access control, consent/privacy, or audit/provenance logging. History / snapshot / status-history / change-log / lifecycle / transaction-log tables map to their BASE BUSINESS resource instead.

Task ONLY for CAS / caseworker work items (assignments, to-dos, reviews, referrals, manual approvals). Not for workflow-engine runtime, batch/scheduler internals, or milestones/stages. Milestones -> Goal; process/batch definitions -> PlanDefinition / ActivityDefinition / OperationDefinition.

domain_remapping_notes.Contact Information: NOT an allowed domain. Remap to People. Address/telecom/email/web/phone records belong to a party/person and map under Patient (or RelatedPerson/Practitioner/Organization).

domain_list.description: Stores information used to support assessment processes, assessment results, scoring, classifications, and related assessment configuration.
Stores information used to support planning, goals, actions, agreements, outcomes, and progress tracking related to service or case planning.
Stores information used to manage cases, case activity, participants, case events, evidence relationships, and the overall case lifecycle.
Stores information related to documents, attachments, notes, templates, document links, and file associations across the application.

domain_list.fhir_equivalent: Account / Claim / ClaimResponse / Invoice / ExplanationOfBenefit / PaymentReconciliation
domain_list.description: Stores information related to financial processing, payment configuration, transactions, rates, deductions, liabilities, and financial outcomes.
Stores information related to legal processes, legal statuses, legal actions, hearings, orders, and related legal relationships.
Stores information related to individuals, personal details, identity, relationships, characteristics, and person-level records.
Stores information related to providers, agencies, services, locations, contracts, service offerings, and provider-related administration.

domain_list.fhir_equivalent: AuditEvent / Provenance / CodeSystem / ValueSet / ConceptMap / StructureDefinition
domain_list.description: Stores technical, configuration, workflow, metadata, resource, and application-level information used to support system functionality.
Stores information related to users, roles, responsibilities, assignments, access structures, and organizational user management.

N/A.meaning: No reviewed FHIR target. Treat as NO_MATCH candidate unless an actual R4 resource reasonably fits.

System.meaning: 'System' is NOT a FHIR resource. Config/admin tables. Prefer an actual resource with PARTIAL_MATCH or NO_MATCH; never Basic.

naming_patterns.meaning: Ontario MCYS custom/extension tables. Map by the CORE concept after the prefix (e.g., MCYSIMMUNIZATIONEXT->Observation, MCYSPERSONEXT->Patient, MCYSMEDICATION->MedicationStatement, MCYSPAPR*->ServiceRequest).
Extension/custom variant of a base Curam table. Map to the same resource as the base concept; custom columns often become extensions (-> PARTIAL_MATCH).
Join/association table. Usually inherits the parent resource (e.g., ACTIONPLANLINK->CarePlan, *ATTACHMENTLINK->DocumentReference), or Linkage for pure record-identity links.
Historical/version snapshot of a base table. Map to the SAME BASE BUSINESS resource as the base concept (a versioned instance). Do NOT default to Provenance/AuditEvent.

Administration/config/definition metadata. Use a definitional resource (Questionnaire / PlanDefinition / ActivityDefinition / OperationDefinition) or NO_MATCH; avoid Basic; do not default to Provenance.
Role/participant association (e.g., ASSESSMENTROLE->RiskAssessment participant; ADMINISTRATIONROLE->PractitionerRole; case-scoped staff role->CareTeam.participant).
Plan family (Care Provision) -> CarePlan; constituent goals/objectives/actions/milestones -> Goal.
Documents -> DocumentReference (or Media for images, e.g., CONCERNROLEIMAGE->Media).
Party/person/demographics -> Patient (People). Contact sub-records -> Patient.address / Patient.telecom / Patient.name.

naming_patterns.pattern: PROGRESS / PLANREVIEW / PLANCOMPONENTREVIEW / EDUCATION / IMMUNIZATION / SOCIALHISTORY

naming_patterns.meaning: Plan milestones -> Goal (Care Provision). Do NOT model milestones as Task.

Workflow-engine/batch RUNTIME has no business meaning -> definitions go to PlanDefinition/ActivityDefinition/OperationDefinition; pure internals -> Parameters/Binary/Library or NO_MATCH. Reserve Task for caseworker work items only.
Only these security/audit/consent-purpose tables may use Consent / AuditEvent / Provenance.
